block-guide: CORE/AUDIO An audio file from the media library in the browser's own player. A Spotify or SoundCloud address is core/embed. MARKUP (checked in the editor) and come from list-media {kind:"audio"} or upload-media. The id goes only in the comment (no class on the tag); src is the file's url. controls is always written.
